newsitem.title: USA: Bluegreen Corp sees Q1 oper results higher.
newsitem.headline: Bluegreen Corp sees Q1 oper results higher.

text.p: Bluegreen Corp said Wednesday that it expects to substantially improve operating results for the three months ended June 29, 1997 over the comparable prior year quarter.
The company reported a loss of $0.20 per share in the 1996 first quarter.
"It will be substantially better than that. It will be a profit," said company Vice President Mary Jo Wiegand.
The company attributed its outlook to higher sales, improved profit margins and lower provisions for losses.

The company recently added to its three existing vacation resorts with the purchase of The Falls Village Resort in Branson, Missouri, and the development of Harbour Lights in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina.
